prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent photographic inventory cutout for the Super Wash button in a racing game's garage. Primary request: make automatic whole-car washing unmistakable at a small 80-pixel thumbnail. Subject: one compact automatic rollover car-wash gantry, a complete silver and graphite portal-shaped machine with two large vertical cylindrical washing brushes and one horizontal overhead washing roller. A small generic unbranded blue hatchback sits visibly centered underneath, being cleaned by the machine; no person operates it. The brushes have tactile warm ivory microfiber bristles like a premium chenille wash mitt, and the gantry has brushed steel, charcoal rubber and black mechanical drive housings like a professional hose nozzle. Show credible powered roller axles and the single connected supporting arch. These are real washing-machine components with natural materials, not pictograms. Style: photorealistic isolated catalogue product photography, physically plausible industrial detailing, broad soft studio lighting from upper left, subtle warm reflections, realistic bristles, metal and rubber. Composition: complete machine and car fully visible, near-frontal three-quarter view with a small amount of depth, centered square image, simple strong arch-and-brush silhouette, occupies 85 percent of the canvas with comfortable transparent margins. Avoid tiny background details; the car and three rollers should read immediately at thumbnail size. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no scene, no large cast shadow. Text: none. Constraints: no people or hands, no handheld spray gun, no logos or branding, no lettering or numbers, no arrows, no vector artwork, no UI frame, no glowing effects, no floating sparkle symbols, no dense foam hiding the car. Match high-quality studio photographs of a cream microfiber mitt and a metal-and-black-rubber hose nozzle.
treatment: Provider PNG copied byte-exactly; transparent alpha preserved. Same lossless, maximum-512px mipmapped import and alpha-border correction as mitt/hose. Previous super-v1 artwork retained. No runtime generation.
